title: An In Silico Molecular Modelling-Based Prediction of Potential Keap1 Inhibitors from Hemidesmus indicus (L.) R.Br. against Oxidative-Stress-Induced Diseases.
authors: Vellur, Senthilkumar; Pavadai, Parasuraman; Babkiewicz, Ewa; Ram Kumar Pandian, Sureshbabu; Maszczyk, Piotr; Kunjiappan, Selvaraj
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物化合物与Keap1蛋白的分子对接和MD模拟，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无AI或TF-DNA相关建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The present study investigated the antioxidant potential of aqueous methanolic extracts of Hemidesmus indicus (L.) R.Br., followed by a pharmacoinformatics-based screening of novel Keap1 protein inhibitors. Initially, the antioxidant potential of this plant extract was assessed via antioxidant assays (DPPH, ABTS radical scavenging, and FRAP). Furthermore, 69 phytocompounds in total were derived from this plant using the IMPPAT database, and their three-dimensional structures were obtained from the PubChem database. The chosen 69 phytocompounds were docked against the Kelch-Neh2 complex protein (PDB entry ID: 2flu, resolution 1.50 A) along with the standard drug (CPUY192018). H. indicus (L.) R.Br. extract (100 microg x mL(-1)) showed 85 +/- 2.917%, 78.783 +/- 0.24% of DPPH, ABTS radicals scavenging activity, and 161 +/- 4 mug x mol (Fe (II)) g(-1) ferric ion reducing power. The three top-scored hits, namely Hemidescine (-11.30 Kcal x mol(-1)), Beta-Amyrin (-10.00 Kcal x mol(-1)), and Quercetin (-9.80 Kcal x mol(-1)), were selected based on their binding affinities. MD simulation studies showed that all the protein-ligand complexes (Keap1-HEM, Keap1-BET, and Keap1-QUE) were highly stable during the entire simulation period, compared with the standard CPUY192018-Keap1 complex. Based on these findings, the three top-scored phytocompounds may be used as significant and safe Keap1 inhibitors, and could potentially be used for the treatment of oxidative-stress-induced health complications.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了印度菝葜（Hemidesmus indicus (L.) R.Br.）水甲醇提取物的抗氧化潜力，并随后进行了基于药物信息学的新型Keap1蛋白抑制剂筛选。首先，通过抗氧化测定（DPPH、ABTS自由基清除及FRAP）评估了该植物提取物的抗氧化潜力。此外，利用IMPPAT数据库从该植物中总共获得69种植物化合物，并从PubChem数据库获取其三维结构。将选定的69种植物化合物与Kelch-Neh2复合蛋白（PDB条目ID：2flu，分辨率1.50 Å）及标准药物（CPUY192018）进行分子对接。印度菝葜（L.）R.Br.提取物（100微克×毫升⁻¹）显示出85 ± 2.917%的DPPH自由基清除活性、78.783 ± 0.24%的ABTS自由基清除活性，以及161 ± 4微克×摩尔（Fe（II））克⁻¹的铁离子还原能力。基于结合亲和力，选出了三个得分最高的化合物，即Hemidescine（-11.30千卡×摩尔⁻¹）、β-香树脂醇（Beta-Amyrin，-10.00千卡×摩尔⁻¹）和槲皮素（Quercetin，-9.80千卡×摩尔⁻¹）。分子动力学模拟研究表明，与标准CPUY192018-Keap1复合物相比，所有蛋白质-配体复合物（Keap1-HEM、Keap1-BET和Keap1-QUE）在整个模拟期间均高度稳定。基于这些发现，这三个得分最高的植物化合物可能作为重要且安全的Keap1抑制剂，并可能用于治疗氧化应激引起的健康并发症。
